name: Tomorrow.io
label: Tomorrow.io
description: Tomorrow.io official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: realtime, forecast, historical, timelines. Docs: https://docs.tomorrow.io/reference/realtime-weather. Tomorrow.io REST v4 (https://api.tomorrow.io/v4). Auth apikey query (https://docs.tomorrow.io/reference/api-authentication). timesteps=best on /timelines is deprecated and returns 1h. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Tomorrow.io request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"realtime"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: realtime | forecast | historical | timelines. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'realtime'.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Comma-separated Tomorrow fields for timelines. Example: temperature,humidity,windSpeed.

schema.label: location
schema.description: Lat,lon or place name. Required on all weather ops. Example: 42.3478,-71.0466 or new york.

schema.label: timesteps
schema.description: Timestep list. forecast/historical/timelines. Accepted includes 1m | 5m | 15m | 30m | 1h | 1d. Example: 1h.

schema.label: units
schema.description: EXACT: metric | imperial | si. All weather ops. Example: metric.

schema.label: startTime
schema.description: ISO8601 start for timelines / forecast / historical. Example: 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z. https://docs.tomorrow.io/reference/weather-forecast

schema.label: endTime
schema.description: ISO8601 end for timelines / forecast / historical. Example: 2026-01-16T00:00:00Z.

schema.label: timezone
schema.description: IANA timezone for timelines. Example: America/New_York.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: realtime, forecast, historical, timelines.

configurationParameters.label: Apikey
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
